# Execution environment

<!-- Generated by harness.agent_home.plugin_build; do not edit. -->

This plugin provides method guidance and scripts, not a prepared Python/R environment.
Check the selected interpreter, package versions, system tools and task data before
running code. Use the installed method only when its assumptions fit the task;
otherwise report the specific missing capability.

The source project's bio-k-dense Research Image declares a Python 3.12 environment
at `/opt/venv` and separate Python 3.11 environments for scvelo and histolab. Those
paths and packages apply only when actually running that image; they are not facts
about the current host. R package availability also differs by image variant.

An opt-in environment installer is included at `<plugin root>/scripts/setup_env.py`.
Read `<plugin root>/env/README.md`, then run the installer with `list` to discover
supported domains and `check --domain foundation` to inspect foundation's current
state. For a supported domain, `install --domain foundation --install-r` installs
its declared Python/R dependencies; `--skip-r` explicitly limits checks and
installation to Python. Use the absolute script path in tool calls. The installer
has the verified `foundation` profile and the broader `biomystery-full` profile.
For bioinformatics dependencies missing from foundation or Dockerfile-style setup,
read `<plugin root>/env/biomystery-full/README.md` first. It maps the Dockerfile's
dependencies to Python/R installer stages and separate platform-specific system,
conda, CLI, uv and ossutil steps. The full profile has not been installed end to
end; do not claim verified full coverage based on a dry-run or foundation's result.
Follow the selected method's requirements for anything not declared.
Dependencies are stored outside the plugin
tree; use the resulting Python interpreter or R library when running a method.
Installing the plugin itself never runs this installer.

If dependencies are missing, explicitly tell the user that additional runtime
dependencies are required. Before running an installation command, explain in the
user's language what will be installed, the actual target directory, and the
network and disk usage involved. If `--install-r` will install a missing R
interpreter, also mention R and its system dependencies being installed through
the platform package manager. Explicitly warn when the setup is large, using the
installed-size guidance in `env/README.md`; do not present disk usage as download
size. Follow the notice guidance in `env/README.md`; do not silently install dependencies.

No MCP server, container execution bridge or model credential is included.
Original method frontmatter is preserved for provenance. Read does not
apply its allowed-tools, model, hooks, fork context, or shell/argument substitutions.
Use absolute script/resource paths, keep inputs and outputs in the task workspace,
and do not write into the installed plugin tree. Reading a reference adds its text
to context but does not create a separately activated or recoverable Skill.
